regime_context: Canada/TSX detector: Big Banks lead with high durability and breadth but are crowded; the absolute-trend gate historically improved drawdown control. No dominant one-narrative structure. Utilities show broad, durable trend without crowding, while Base Metals trend is narrow and fragile.
emerging_watch: Pipelines & Midstream — monitor for a potential leadership handoff if the rotation margin vs Big Banks closes to <0.3 and durability remains above 0.7. Kill criterion: margin stays >0.5 over the next 10 trading days.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Leader in momentum rank, full breadth (1.0) and durable (0.72) trend, eligible per the validated absolute-trend gate. Crowding flags a sizing caution, not a fade; the trend discipline remains supportive.
theses.dissent: Crowding and mixed Hurst tag may indicate late-cycle behavior; reflexivity could reverse sharply if macro sentiment shifts.

falsifier.text: If Big Banks loses eligibility (absolute trend gate flips to ineligible) or breadth drops below 0.5.

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Strong trend health: high breadth (0.846), solid durability (0.65), eligible, and not crowded. Offers a defensive tilt consistent with the geopolitics-heavy macro backdrop, without reflexivity risk.
theses.dissent: Momentum rank is only 7; the theme may lag if risk-on dominates and rates stay high, muting utility outperformance.

falsifier.text: If eligibility flips to ineligible or durability drops below 0.5 for 5 consecutive trading days.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Eligible but the trend is fragile: very narrow breadth (0.111) and low durability (0.47); high probability of shake-out amid mixed Hurst behaviour.
theses.dissent: A sudden supply shock or copper deficit narrative could override weak breadth and lead to a sharp rally.

falsifier.text: If breadth expands above 0.5 and durability exceeds 0.6 for 5 consecutive trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
